title: The Hartree-Fock code, in the order a calculation runs

stages.name: What a calculation is handed
stages.why: The molecule, the basis and the settings, as plain arrays. Every other file agrees to these layouts.
files: The settings vector: electron counts, iteration limits, which strategy each stage uses.
What a contracted Gaussian is, and how it is normalized to match PySCF.

stages.name: The special function under every integral
stages.why: Every Coulomb integral reduces to the Boys function F_n(x); getting it wrong poisons everything downstream.
files: Four independent ways to compute F_n(x), held against a 40-digit mpmath table.

stages.name: One-electron integrals: overlap S, kinetic T, nuclear attraction V
stages.why: Three independent families, so each matrix is computed three ways and must agree.
files: The Hermite expansion tables McMurchie-Davidson is built on.
S, T, V by Obara-Saika recurrences (shares no code with the above).
S and T by Gauss-Hermite quadrature (a third, unrelated route).

stages.name: Two-electron integrals (ERIs)
stages.why: The expensive stage: N^4 integrals. Three independent algorithms, plus screening and a direct J/K build.
files: Packed storage with 8-fold symmetry, checksums and samples.
ERIs by McMurchie-Davidson, with Schwarz screening.
J and K built directly from integrals, never storing them (for large molecules).

stages.name: Cartesian to spherical
stages.why: Research basis sets use 5 d functions, not 6. This transform is where PySCF's conventions are easiest to get wrong.
files: The transform matrix, built two independent ways.
Applying it to two-index and four-index integrals.

stages.name: The SCF iteration
stages.why: Build the Fock matrix, diagonalize, rebuild the density, repeat until self-consistent.
files: Three ways to orthogonalize the basis (symmetric, canonical, Cholesky).
Three eigensolvers for the Fock matrix.
Density from orbitals; the energy computed two ways; the convergence measure.
Coulomb J and exchange K from the integrals.
Damping, level shift, DIIS: ways to make the iteration converge faster.
Unrestricted HF: open shells, separate alpha and beta orbitals.
Restricted open-shell HF, with three coupling schemes that must agree.

stages.name: Putting it together
stages.why: One call from molecule to energy, and the programs that lock the result against PySCF.
files: Every stage's registry of strategies on one page.
Is the solution a true minimum? Stability analysis.
Reading order and how to run the checks.
Water, end to end, against PySCF.
Water and HF with polarization (d) functions.

stages.name: How it is checked
stages.why: The cross-checking machinery: independent strategies must agree, random inputs, and PySCF's own tests.
files: Run every strategy, take the median, blame the one that disagrees.
Random molecules and shells, with quotable seeds.
Relations that must hold without knowing the answer (rotation, translation).
Which cases were actually exercised by at least two strategies.
Interval arithmetic: bounds instead of samples.
PySCF's own 108 test assertions, harvested and classified.
How many of PySCF's tests this code passes.

stages.name: Reference data (generated, not written by hand)
stages.why: PySCF's numbers, written out so the Viv code can be held against them. Thousands of values; read the generator, not the output.
files: The generator: runs PySCF and writes every lib/hfref module.
